chapters.title: Intro
sentences: Here is your portfolio briefing for the period ending 15 Nov, covering 3 items that need your attention.

chapters.title: TATAPOWER · Q2 FY27 results
sentences: Tata Power announced Q2 FY27 results with revenue up 26% year on year and EBITDA margin down 257 basis points.
Adjusted profit after tax rose 22%, excluding a 119 crore rupees one-off gain, while reported profit after tax increased 33%.
The stock fell 0.8% in the next session, down 1.0% versus the NIFTY.

chapters.title: KAYNES · Q2 FY27 results
sentences: This update challenges your EMS business growth driver for Kaynes Technology.
The company reported Q2 FY27 results with profit after tax down 67% as profit after tax dropped heavily.
Meanwhile, revenue rose 5.1% year on year during the quarter.

chapters.title: HAL · Q2 FY27 results
sentences: Hindustan Aeronautics delivered Q2 FY27 results, showing revenue up 15% year on year alongside profit after tax up 16%.
However, the company's EBITDA margin was down 66 basis points for the period.
In the next session, the stock fell 2.1%, which was down 2.3% versus the NIFTY.
